name: agentic-ai-platform
description: AI consulting SaaS platform with dual-agent architecture

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=frontend && cd backend && python -m pytest
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && cd backend && python -m flake8
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=frontend && cd backend && python -m black .
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=frontend && cd backend && find . -name __pycache__ -exec rm -rf {} +
